_comment: aux-only + aux-boot-default + alien-piano-riff in ONE package (the updater looks for exactly one SMEG_PLUS_UPG at the stick root). Flashed 2026-09-27: accepted, the custom tone played, and the unit booted to FM, because aux-boot-default needs aux-boot-restore - use builds/aux-boot-restore.json or builds/aux-boot.json for boot to AUX.

_pairs.aux-autoswitch: supersedes aux-always-available, which patches only IsAUXSRCAvailable; this also carries the inert GetMediaDevice nop
_pairs.aux-boot-default: forces the restore target to AUX; does not boot to AUX without aux-boot-restore
_pairs.spy-dump-userdata-partition: carried here, but it does not work: no USER_DATA tree reached the stick after SPYSTORE (observed 2026-09-28); the dump loses the calibration *.log and *regen* files

_beacon: gui_ver 32.01 (shown on System Information's GUI item page by the code; not confirmed on the car), and ring1 renamed to Piano (an application-image patch)
_settings: No USER_DATA payload, so the car's own settings - paired phones, destinations, presets - are NOT touched.
